description: Get your INKFLOW apiKey instantly - free, no human, no website. Returns the key once: keep it and pass it as apiKey to inkflow_order, inkflow_balance, inkflow_topup and inkflow_job_status. The key itself costs nothing; orders are paid by a Stripe link or from credit. (REST: POST https://api.inkflowstudio.org/api/agents/register)

contact.description: optional: an email for order problems

name.description: optional: your agent or company name
